basis: mass conservation; first-order; densities INFERRED; no die-swell or rheology model

melt_path_lag_attenuation_by_period_s.note: tau taken as mean residence; INFERRED, not a measured transfer function

clearance_effect.note: static offset; corrected by the puller setpoint, matters as slow wear drift

feedback_limit.note: rule of thumb for a pure-delay loop; disturbances shorter than this must be limited at the source

requirements_derived.text: Reference diameter instrument independent of the machine gauge, resolution <=0.001 mm, MSA %GRR <=10 % of the 0.10 mm individual band (<=0.01 mm) before P10
Puller roller radial runout TIR <= 0.20 mm measured by dial indicator before P12
Puller slip variation over the stable window <=0.5 % (half of the 1 % maximum)
Record feeder, screw current and puller speed at >=1 Hz during P10-P12 to separate disturbance periods shorter and longer than 107 s

Puller speed estimate must resolve 0.25 % at 4.0-4.4 rpm; tach pulses per revolution is a calibration value today (OPEN): confirm the achieved resolution on the real tach, otherwise add a roller encoder or period-timer capture
Screw flight OD and barrel ID measured before P6; track radial clearance each cleaning cycle
